generic.brom_keys: Power off, hold Vol Up or Vol Down, plug in USB (MediaTek)
generic.edl_keys: adb reboot edl (Qualcomm) or test point
generic.fastboot_keys: Vol Down + Power, or: adb reboot bootloader
generic.notes: Fallback profile used when no brand matches. Identify the device and add a profile.
generic.recovery_keys: Vol Up + Power, or: adb reboot recovery

unlock.method: Enable OEM unlocking in Developer options, then: fastboot flashing unlock
notes: Unlocking wipes the phone. Always back up first.
If the brand is unknown, identify the chipset first (adb shell getprop ro.hardware) and match the protocol: MTK -> BROM, Qualcomm -> EDL, Unisoc -> SPD download mode.
unlock.wait: Varies by brand — see the brand profile

note: Unlock policy is set by the manufacturer and changes without notice. Verify against the vendor's current documentation before buying a phone to flash. Sources: vendor unlock pages, awesome-android-root bootloader guide (updated 2026-06-05), droidrooter.com 2026 guide (checked 2026-11-05), customdroid.info.

profiles.download_keys: Vol Down + plug in USB (newer); Vol Down + Home + Power (older)
profiles.notes: No fastboot at all — Samsung uses Download mode + Odin protocol.

unlock.method: Download mode (Odin) — enable OEM unlocking, boot to Download mode, long-press Vol Up to unlock
notes: One UI 8.0 removed the OEM unlocking toggle entirely — assume One UI 8+ cannot be unlocked.
US/Canada Snapdragon models generally cannot unlock the bootloader.
Unlocking permanently trips Knox (hardware eFuse): Samsung Pay/Wallet, Secure Folder and work profiles stay blocked even after relock.
KnoxGuard / RMM state can block unlocking until the phone has been online and activated.
unlock.wait: 7 days after first setup / KnoxGuard check on some models

profiles.edl_keys: Vol Up + Vol Down + plug in USB, or test point
profiles.notes: EDL (9008) mode is common on Qualcomm Xiaomi phones; auth is required for newer models.

unlock.method: Mi Unlock Tool (Windows) after binding a Mi Account in Developer options > Mi Unlock status
notes: HyperOS requires applying for unlock permission in the Xiaomi Community app first.
China-region phones are effectively closed to official unlock.
Unisoc-based Xiaomi phones cannot be unlocked.
Do not factory-reset or sign out of the Mi Account after binding — the timer resets.
unlock.wait: 168 hours (7 days) on MIUI; ~72 hours on HyperOS after Community-app permission; 1 phone per 30 days, 4 per year per account

profiles.edl_keys: Vol Up + Vol Down + plug in USB, or test point
profiles.notes: MTK models use BROM; Qualcomm models use EDL.

notes: Getting a code voids the warranty (Motorola states this explicitly).
Carrier-locked models may not qualify for a code.
A permanent unlock warning shows on every boot afterwards.

profiles.fastboot_keys: Vol Up + plug in USB (blue LED = fastboot)

unlock.method: Unlock code from Sony's developer site, then fastboot oem unlock 0x<code>
notes: Unlocking permanently erases the DRM security keys: camera processing (e.g. low-light noise reduction) can degrade.
Some models lose Widevine L1 / streaming HD after unlock.
